nodes.label: Markdown EducationEntry Template
nodes.rationale: Only entry template that conditionally renders a degree column, gated on design.templates.education_entry.degree_column from the active theme configuration.

nodes.label: Ember Theme Design Config
nodes.rationale: Warm red/brown palette (Gentium Book Plus name, Ubuntu body), centered header with dot-separated connections, centered_without_line section titles, diamond bullets.

nodes.label: Engineering Classic Theme Design Config
nodes.rationale: Raleway everywhere with full-line section titles and a left-aligned header; entry templates lead with the position for experience entries.

nodes.label: Engineering Resumes Theme Design Config
nodes.rationale: Minimal all-black XCharter design with no footer, URL-style connections separated by pipes, and tight spacing tuned for single-column engineering resumes.

nodes.label: Harvard Theme Design Config
nodes.rationale: All-black serif XCharter theme with centered_with_centered_partial_line section titles, no top note, and an empty time_span template so durations are never shown.

nodes.label: ModernCV Theme Design Config
nodes.rationale: Fontin-based recreation of the LaTeX moderncv look using the dedicated moderncv section-title type with a thick 0.15cm rule and photo support in the header.

nodes.label: Opal Theme Design Config
nodes.rationale: Teal-green Lato theme with centered header and icons, centered_without_line section titles, and short_second_row enabled for compact entries.

nodes.label: Sb2nov Theme Design Config
nodes.rationale: New Computer Modern all-black theme mirroring the sb2nov LaTeX resume: full-line section titles, hyperlinked URL connections, and location stacked above the date in the right column.

nodes.label: Centered Section Title Styles
nodes.rationale: Four centered section title styles (centered_without_line, centered_with_partial_line, centered_with_centered_partial_line, centered_with_full_line) were added in 0.3.0 alongside the Harvard theme example, enabling centered-header theme designs.

nodes.label: RenderCV Typst Package (@preview/rendercv)
nodes.rationale: A single Typst package produces all six theme looks purely through different parameter values passed to rendercv.with(), rather than separate per-theme packages; the RenderCV CLI and web app use this same package under the hood.

nodes.label: RTL Language Support
nodes.rationale: Added in 0.2.0 via a text-direction parameter accepting native Typst ltr/rtl values so that all layout elements (grids, insets, section titles, top note) mirror correctly for right-to-left languages such as Persian.

nodes.label: Full HTML Page Template
nodes.rationale: Wraps the rendered markdown body (html_body) in a GitHub-markdown-styled page; KaTeX loading is deferred to speed up page rendering, with math auto-rendered on $$ delimiters.

nodes.label: User-Friendly Error Translation
nodes.rationale: Raw Pydantic validation error messages are too technical for YAML-authoring end users, so each Pydantic message is mapped to a plain-language explanation with concrete format examples (dates, DOI prefixes, colors, phone numbers).

nodes.label: Ink Theme Design Config
nodes.rationale: Deep purple EB Garamond design with small-caps line-free section titles, left-aligned header, and URL-style pipe-separated connections.
